procedure: 1. Register real DEX files and at least 3 sourced APKs (covering multi-DEX and complex manifests, different producer versions - not three recompressions of one sample) in tests/fixtures/contracts/corpus/ with source, version, license and sha256 for each; samples that cannot be legally redistributed stay manifest-only with a documented acquisition path. 2. Run all four reference query kinds plus fixed-point source checks on every corpus sample and record the results as facts. 3. Report any sample class that cannot be sourced yet as blocked rather than shrinking the matrix.
pass_criteria: Corpus registry is complete with provenance and hashes; all four reference kinds return non-empty results on the real samples; fixed-point source facts verified; no sample is committed without redistribution rights.
